_comment: 013: signals -- the map's events. A signal site shows one (seeded, never twice in a run) and the player picks an option. Every option states its whole cost and gain up front: no hidden dice. Effects, applied in this order: scrap (+/-; a cost needs that much scrap or the option is refused), hp (every living machine, never below 1 or above full), hp_one (the first living machine), part (a part of at least that rarity into the hold), tuned_part (the same, already tuned), reveal (scout every site within that many columns), front (the Reclaimer takes that many columns now), fight (skirmish|elite: a fight here, rewarded as that kind). In the content hash: effects are rules.

hauler_wreck.title: A CRASHED HAULER
hauler_wreck.text: A Combine hauler lies on its side, cargo doors sprung. Something inside still hums, and the wreck is not as settled as it looks.

options.label: STRIP IT
options.text: An uncommon part or better. The wreck shifts while you work: every machine takes 2.

lone_rig.title: A SPIKED RIG, ALONE
lone_rig.text: One of the Reclaimer's heavy rigs has thrown a track and its escort is circling back for it. It has not seen you yet.

options.label: BREAK IT
options.text: A fight here against an elite and its escort, for an elite's salvage.

scavengers.title: SCAVENGERS AT A FIRE
scavengers.text: Free machines from another yard, sharing a fire. They have parts to trade, and time to look at yours.

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Pay 12 scrap for a tuned part.

relay_mast.title: A RELAY MAST
relay_mast.text: A Combine relay mast, still standing. From the top you would see half the yard. Its copper would buy a lot.

options.label: CLIMB IT
options.text: Scout every site within two columns.

tool_locker.title: A SEALED TOOL LOCKER
tool_locker.text: A foreman's locker, welded shut and wired. Whatever is in there, someone wanted it kept.

options.label: FORCE IT
options.text: A rare part. The locker's charge goes off in the first machine's face: it takes 4.

downed_drone.title: A DOWNED DRONE
downed_drone.text: One of the Reclaimer's scouts, down in the dirt, its core still warm. Taking it will not go unnoticed.

options.label: TAKE ITS CORE
options.text: A tuned uncommon part. The Reclaimer takes a column now.

fuel_cache.title: A FUEL CACHE
fuel_cache.text: Drums of clean fuel, sealed before the Combine left. The machines run better on it, and the drums are worth something empty.

options.label: REFUEL
options.text: Every machine is patched for 2, and +6 scrap.
